title: See Financial Data OFF: money amounts, rates, costs and margins are hidden
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role that has See Financial Data OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user and open a work order; look for any money amount.
  2. Open Customers and look.
  3. Open Parts and look.
  4. Open Vendors and look.
  5. Open Reports and look.
custom_expected:
No money amounts are shown on any page.

The user can still do their normal add/edit actions, but all pricing fields are hidden.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs a live user with SFD OFF + manual page sweep)
evidence: App-wide hidden-pricing sweep needs a seeded SFD-off role + manual UI pass.
